parameters.name: AutoSnapshotPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.

parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The file system type.

Valid value: extreme (Extreme NAS file system).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of automatic snapshot policies on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.
